narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>You must measure every side with a ruler to know its length.
<bookmark mark='ruler'/>Measuring would tell us, but we do not need it here. The square already has the answer inside it.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A property that holds for every square can do the work of a ruler.

<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A square has a side of twelve centimetres. How long is the side next to it, and why?
